pH.name: pH
pH.stress_threshold: <6.5 dissolves shell nacre; >9.0 increases ammonia toxicity

turbidity.name: Turbidity
turbidity.stress_threshold: >80 NTU clogs mussel ctenidia and gills

hardness.name: Total Hardness
hardness.stress_threshold: <50 mg/L leads to brittle shell and poor nacre mineralization

alkalinity.name: Total Alkalinity
alkalinity.stress_threshold: <40 mg/L causes severe diurnal pH swings

salinity.name: Salinity
salinity.stress_threshold: <20 ppt during monsoon runoff causes acute mortality in Pinctada fucata

temperature_low.action: Water temperature is below optimal. Reduce shading or wait for seasonal warming. Monitor mussel activity.

temperature_high.action: Water temperature exceeds threshold. Increase aeration or freshwater flow. Lower cage depth to cooler stratum (1.5 m).

pH_low.action: Low pH (<7.0) dissolves shells. Apply agricultural lime (CaCO3) or dolomite at 200 kg/ha. Retest after 48h.

pH_high.action: High pH (>8.5) risks ammonia toxicity. Exchange 15-20% pond water and reduce excess organic fertilization.

dissolved_oxygen_low.action: Dissolved oxygen is critically low (<5 mg/L). Immediately activate mechanical aerators or pump fresh water. Re-test within 2 hours.

dissolved_oxygen_high.action: Oxygen supersaturation from heavy algal bloom. Monitor for gas bubble stress. Discontinue fertilizer input.

turbidity_high.action: Turbidity is excessive. Check catchment runoff. Delay surgery or handling until silt settles.

salinity_low.action: Low salinity from heavy runoff. Lower marine droppers to deeper salinity layers or relocate oysters to sheltered bays.

salinity_high.action: High salinity from summer evaporation. Introduce freshwater exchange if in coastal pond/lagoon.

hardness_low.action: Low calcium/hardness restricts nacre formation. Apply agricultural gypsum or calcium carbonate to raise hardness >75 mg/L.

alkalinity_low.action: Low alkalinity weakens pH buffering capacity. Apply agricultural lime (CaCO3) to buffer water.
